title: Study: Electrical Medical Device Helps Improve Muscle Strength
titleZh: 研究：电气医疗设备有助于增强肌肉力量
credits: Lauran Neergaard reported this story for the Associated Press. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: Researchers recently reported new evidence from a study of a medical device placed inside the body, a spine-stimulating implant.
sentences.zh: 研究人员最近公布了一项针对植入体内的医疗设备的最新研究成果，这是一种刺激脊柱的植入装置。

sentences.en: Three people with a muscle-destroying disease got a little stronger after using the implant.
sentences.zh: 三名患有肌肉萎缩症的患者在使用该植入装置后，力量有所增强。

sentences.en: They were able to stand and walk more easily because of electrical stimulation to their spinal cord.
sentences.zh: 由于对脊髓进行电刺激，他们能够更轻松地站立和行走。

sentences.en: Marco Capogrosso is an assistant professor at the University of Pittsburg, or Pitt, who led the research.
sentences.zh: 马可·卡普罗索是匹兹堡大学（又称匹大）的助理教授，他领导了这项研究。

sentences.en: "These people were definitely not expecting an improvement," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说："这些人肯定没有预料到会有改善。"

sentences.en: Capogrosso said, "They were getting better and better," over the study that lasted one month.
sentences.zh: 卡普罗索说，在这项为期一个月的研究中，"他们越来越好。"

sentences.en: The implant was able to return some muscle function, at least temporarily.
sentences.zh: 该植入装置能够恢复部分肌肉功能，至少是暂时性的。

sentences.en: The implant was already being tested to treat paralysis in other patients.
sentences.zh: 该植入装置此前已在其他患者身上进行测试，用于治疗瘫痪。

sentences.en: This new evidence suggests it might also aid diseases of the nervous system like spinal muscle atrophy, or SMA.
sentences.zh: 这项新的证据表明，它或许也能治疗神经系统疾病，如脊髓性肌肉萎缩症（SMA）。

sentences.en: SMA is a genetic disease that slowly destroys motor neurons, nerve cells in the spinal cord that control muscles.
sentences.zh: SMA是一种遗传病，会缓慢破坏运动神经元，即控制肌肉的脊髓神经细胞。

sentences.en: That leads muscles to waste away, especially in the legs, hips, and shoulders and sometimes those involved with breathing and swallowing.
sentences.zh: 这会导致肌肉萎缩，尤其是腿部、臀部和肩部，有时也会影响与呼吸和吞咽相关的肌肉。

sentences.en: There is no cure.
sentences.zh: 目前尚无疗法。

sentences.en: A gene therapy can save the lives of very young children with a severe form of the disease, and there are some medicines to slow the disease in older patients.
sentences.zh: 基因疗法可以挽救患有该病严重形式的婴幼儿的生命，而对于年长患者，也有一些药物可以延缓病情。

sentences.en: Stimulating the spinal cord with low levels of electricity has long been used to treat chronic, or long-term, pain.
sentences.zh: 利用低强度电流刺激脊髓，长期以来被用于治疗慢性或长期疼痛。

sentences.en: Capogrosso's team also has tested it to help people paralyzed by strokes or spinal cord injury move their arms and legs with assistance.
sentences.zh: 卡普罗索的团队还将它用于帮助因中风或脊髓损伤而瘫痪的人借助装置移动手臂和腿。

sentences.en: The system sends electrical signals to nerves that have stopped reacting.
sentences.zh: 该系统向已停止反应的神经发送电信号。

sentences.en: This has the effect of activating the muscles.
sentences.zh: 其效果是激活肌肉。

sentences.en: Capogrosso wondered if that same technology might help patients with SMA by stimulating sensory nerves to signal damaged muscle cells causing them to move.
sentences.zh: 卡普罗索想知道，同样的技术是否能够通过刺激感觉神经，向受损的肌肉细胞发出信号，从而帮助SMA患者使肌肉运动。

sentences.en: The researchers at the University of Pittsburgh published their study in Nature Medicine.
sentences.zh: 匹兹堡大学的研究人员将他们的研究成果发表在《自然医学》杂志上。

sentences.en: They implanted electrodes over the lower spinal cord of the three adults with SMA.
sentences.zh: 他们将电极植入了这三名SMA成年患者的下段脊髓。

sentences.en: Using the device did not return normal movement but with a few hours of spinal stimulation a week, all soon experienced improvements in muscle strength and function, the researchers wrote.
sentences.zh: 研究人员写道，使用该设备并未带来正常的行走能力，但每周进行几小时的脊髓刺激后，所有受试者很快都出现了肌肉力量和功能的改善。

sentences.en: Fifty-seven-year-old Doug McCullough took part in the study.
sentences.zh: 57道格·麦卡卢夫参与了这项研究。

sentences.en: "With a progressive disease you never get any better," he said, adding, “So having any improvement is just a really surreal and very exciting benefit."
sentences.zh: "患有进行性疾病的人永远不会好转，"他说，并补充道，"所以任何改善都是一种极其超现实且令人非常兴奋的收益。"

sentences.en: All three subjects increased how far they could walk in six minutes by the study's end.
sentences.zh: 到研究结束时，三名受试者的六分钟步行距离都有所增加。

sentences.en: Capogrosso said they could walk farther because they got less tired and “even a person this many years into the disease can improve."
sentences.zh: 卡普罗索罗说，他们能够走得更远，是因为他们不那么容易疲劳，"甚至患病多年的人也能改善。"

sentences.en: Researchers found the improvements did not disappear as soon as the stimulator was turned off.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现，当刺激器关闭后，这些改善并不会立即消失。

sentences.en: But they did decrease a few months after the study ended.
sentences.zh: 但在研究结束几个月后，改善程度有所下降。

sentences.en: Neuroscientist Susan Harkema led similar studies of stimulation for spinal cord injuries while at the University of Louisville.
sentences.zh: 神经科学家苏珊·哈克玛在路易斯维尔大学期间曾主导过类似的脊髓损伤刺激研究。

sentences.en: She warned that the new study is small and did not last very long but said it was an important test of the device.
sentences.zh: 她警告说，这项研究规模较小且持续时间不长，但称这是对设备的一次重要测试。

sentences.en: She said it should be tested next with other muscle-degenerating diseases.
sentences.zh: 她表示，接下来应在其他肌肉退行性疾病中进行测试。

sentences.en: Capogrosso said some small but longer studies are beginning.
sentences.zh: 卡普罗索罗说，一些规模较小但持续时间更长的研究已经开始。

sentences.en: I’m Dorothy Gundy.
sentences.zh: 我是多萝西·冈迪。
